start_proof.lease_takeover_reason: Previous SUP12 lease exceeded the canonical 10-minute TTL without fresh material progress; SUP24 acquired the single-writer lease after read-before-write.
start_proof.lease_conflict_recovery: During REVIEW_FIRST, a concurrent SUP12 telemetry write overwrote lease token/status metadata while owner identity still pointed to SUP24. SUP24 detected the conflict, re-read CONFIG and HEAD, reasserted the exact original token and refreshed the heartbeat with write/readback before this evidence write.
